items.name: Priya S.
items.text: Our launch flyers and standees were ready faster than the venue setup. Colour matched the PDF proof — no surprises at pickup from BTM.

items.name: Arjun M.
items.text: Cards and team tees in one place. Fast Prints handled sizing and artwork checks so we could focus on demos. Same-day pickup saved us.

items.name: Neha R.
items.text: Invitation folio with premium finish — guests keep asking where we printed. The team called to confirm paper stock before running the job.

items.name: Ramesh K.
items.text: Weekly offer pamphlets and shop banners at fair bulk rates. Delivery across Bengaluru when we cannot pick up — very reliable.

items.name: Anita V.
items.text: 200 employee ID kits with lanyards — artwork review, proof on WhatsApp, and delivery on the promised date. Exactly what admin teams need.

items.name: Karthik D.
items.text: Menu redesign and counter signage done in two days. Walked in near Metro Pillar 154 — easy to find, friendly team.

items.name: Divya P.
items.text: Annual day certificates and student ID batches every year. Consistent quality and patient with our last-minute changes.

items.name: Suresh N.
items.text: Premium visiting cards and project brochures for client meetings. Good stock options and honest turnaround estimates.

items.name: Meena L.
items.text: Branded tags and gift envelopes for our festive collection. Small quantity was not a problem — they treated it professionally.
